frames.heading: Discord
frames.body: Your groove... it's powerful enough to bring order to even my chaos. Perhaps there is merit in your harmony.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Everyone has a place in the universal symphony, Discord. Now, let's place the final amp and complete our mission.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The ground, it's shaking! The planet is falling out of balance!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: The Grand Composer's reign is coming to an end. With all four platforms united, it's finally time to face him and bring true harmony to the universe.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Let's groove, Traveller. The final stage awaits, and the universe is ready to hear our beat!
